description: This file declares an interface class 'IGstProtectionMetadataWrapper' for managing protection metadata in GStreamer buffers within the Rialto media server component. It includes method declarations for adding, retrieving, and removing protection metadata, and references external classes and types related to GStreamer and protection data.

classes.name: IGstProtectionMetadataWrapper
classes.description: An interface class defining methods for handling protection metadata in GStreamer buffers within the Rialto media server.

methods.name: addProtectionMetadata
methods.description: Adds protection metadata to a GStreamer buffer.

methods.name: getProtectionMetadataData
methods.description: Retrieves protection metadata data from a GStreamer buffer.

methods.name: removeProtectionMetadata
methods.description: Removes protection metadata from a GStreamer buffer.
